title: chore: serve all legacy text cache misses from the worker
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Sets the legacy text cache Worker’s adapter share from 50% to 100%, so the Worker handles every cache miss and /feed while the OVH VM remains running as an unused fallback. /feed streams public events only through the Worker’s FeedHub, matching the VM behavior. Canary checks found no Worker exceptions and a 0.006% 500 rate; a well-formed payment with an invalid signature received the same facilitator rejection, challenge, body, and headers on both paths.
